title: Competition and Firm Service Reliability Decisions: A Study of the Airline Industry
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences design. The paper estimates a simultaneous equation model and a static discrete (incomplete-information) game of airline cancellation and delay choices at the route-airline-quarter level. The only DiD mention is a citation to Fisher, Gallino and Xu (2019). Store/market/year/quarter fixed effects appear as controls in the structural models, and the on-time-bonus 'program' analysis is a counterfactual simulation from the estimated model, not a treatment-timing comparison.
design_notes: Data: US BTS on-time and cancellation records (public), Southwest/American/Delta/United, market-quarter. Model-free Figure 1 shows United's 2009 on-time bonus and its 2010 abandonment for two routes, but no regression with adoption dates is estimated. Fixed effects (market, year, quarter, firm) are footnoted in Tables 4-5 notes.
screener_notes: Screened from article text only; no replication package listed in the batch. Ineligible by design (structural IV/game model, no staggered binary treatment). Candidate flag ft_difference_in_difference came only from a literature-review citation.
